warnings: Table grape orchards are often under overhead plastic or mesh. If this one is covered, NDVI and NDMI (vigour, water stress, abandonment) read the cover, not the plants: confirm before acting.

Stage 'Bloom' comes from the central-Chile table-grape calendar. North of about 31° S (Atacama, Coquimbo) vines run 4–6 weeks earlier, so the real stage is likely later: read stage-dependent frost, heat and rain sensitivities with care.
